countingMethod: One entry per bullet in the official API index (docs/api.md): top-level exports, constructors, instance invocations (*x*) and instance methods (*x*.method). Duplicated bullets are counted once per module.

statusRules.implemented-and-tested: Called by at least one registered renderer; every renderer is exercised by unit and browser tests.
statusRules.implemented-with-constraints: Used only by the in-browser runtime of HTML artifacts (requires JavaScript and the embedded d3 bundle); covered by Playwright tests.
statusRules.available-through-safe-composition: Reachable through a whitelisted d3_execute_composition operation; every operation is exercised by unit tests.
statusRules.documented-but-not-yet-implemented: Listed in the official API index but not used by any renderer, runtime feature, or composition operation.
statusRules.unsupported-by-current-runtime: Intentionally unavailable: d3-fetch (network/file access is disabled by the security policy).
